title: Substrate-independence of computation
html:
Remark. Substrate-independence of computation

Discrete time at the Planck scale replaces analysis with combinatorics. The Toffoli braid P_{7,6}(q) forms a rational function of the substrate parameter q, carrying the numerator factor (q - 1).

This imposes three structural facts:

  1. The q-AND amplitude is non-zero for all q \neq 1.
  2. The combinatorial skeleton of reversible computation persists at every substrate scale.
  3. As the universe cools from the Big Bang (q \to \infty) to the local epoch (q = q_0), the amplitude decreases but never vanishes.

The medium of computation does not alter its logic. The combinatorics depends only on the substrate parameter. The Hecke crossing coefficients at q = q_0 satisfy the exact algebraic relations as at q = 10^{60}. The transfer matrices still multiply. The destructive interference isolating the q-AND remains exact. Computations executed by pebbles or photons inhabit the same Iwahori--Hecke algebra H_n(q) at identical q.

Consistency under descent. Planck-scale combinatorics aligns tightly with local continuous physics. The rationality of P_{7,6}(q) in q^{1/2} guarantees this. The amplitude remains valid over any field where q \neq 1. The polynomial governing a 3-strand braid at the Big Bang also governs it in the laboratory. The passage from discrete to continuous physics does not break logic gates; it merely attenuates the amplitude P_{7,6} and dilates the Planck step t_P(q) = q/(q-1).

At q = q_0, we have P_{7,6}(q_0) = +0.0495 and t_P(q_0) \approx 10.11. The gate operates slowly and with small amplitude, but its operation is a direct algebraic consequence of q \neq 1.

Relation to 't Hooft's CA interpretation. The thesis that quantum mechanics emerges from a deterministic Planck-scale cellular automaton aligns structurally with this framework. Both models posit discrete combinatorics at the Planck scale as the ontological primitive. Both attribute macroscopic quantum superposition to coarse-graining. The QOU substrate formally substitutes 't Hooft's information loss with algebraic coarse-graining via the Markov trace on H_n(q), rendering the emergence of quantum mechanics functorial rather than statistical.
